text: Got it — a whole-number float like months=1.0 should be accepted like months=1. Fix in progress; ETA ~10 min.
Confirmed: count=0 should yield zero occurrences. Fix in progress; ETA ~10 min.
Confirmed: str(rrule) should emit the RRULE: prefix. Fix in progress; ETA ~10 min.

Fixed: whole-number floats for years/months (e.g. months=1.0) are now normalized to ints, so datetime(2000,1,1)+relativedelta(months=1.0) == datetime(2000,2,1); genuinely fractional values (1.5) still raise the same ValueError. Full test suite green.

Fixed: str(rrule) now emits the RRULE: prefix, so you get 'DTSTART:19970902T090000\nRRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=5', and parsing a string containing RRULE: and printing it back preserves the prefix. Full test suite green.
Still working on count=0 (it needs care around the internal iteration/caching). ETA ~8 min.
Looking into the fuzzy_with_tokens URL case; ETA ~12 min.
Looking into the trailing-colon IndexError; ETA ~12 min.
Looking into relativedelta addition dropping explicitly-zero values; ETA ~12 min.
Fixed: relativedelta.__add__/__sub__ now merge absolute fields with None-awareness instead of truthiness, so explicitly-set zeros (day=0, hour=0, etc.) survive on either side. Full test suite green.
